features.name: Shopify Tax Matching AI Capability
features.description: AI-powered capability that analyzes tax information from Shopify orders and automatically finds or creates missing tax jurisdictions, tax areas, and tax details in Business Central to match the complex US sales tax system.
caveats: Only available in the US
Shipped as a Shopify extension
Not published on marketplace
Requires activation in settings
Can be configured to create tax jurisdictions and areas or skip creation

features.name: Tax Area Code Auto-Population
features.description: AI automatically assigns tax area codes to Shopify orders based on tax jurisdictions and shipping information received, creating new tax areas with a configurable prefix if they do not exist.
caveats: AI confidence levels determine whether manual review is required
Low confidence triggers creation of new tax jurisdictions
Prefix is optional but recommended for distinguishing auto-created items

features.name: Tax Match Review and Approval Window
features.description: A dedicated window where users can review AI-assigned tax areas, tax jurisdictions, and associated tax rates before approving changes to Shopify orders.
caveats: Can be skipped for orders with high confidence
Always required if significant issues are detected (missing jurisdiction or rate mismatch)
Shows confidence indicators for each matched jurisdiction

features.name: TaxMatch Automatic Installation
features.description: The TaxMatch agent is automatically installed by default for new installations, detecting US localization and prompting installation on upgrades.
caveats: Only for US localization
Must be explicitly activated in Shopify shop card settings

features.name: TaxMatch Configuration Settings
features.description: Configurable permissions and options including activation toggle, permission to create tax jurisdictions and areas, optional prefix setting, and review frequency (Always, Never, or Low Confidence Only).
caveats: Review setting defaults to Always but can be set to Never
Creating missing items can be disabled in favor of manual setup or imports from other sources
Prefix is optional but recommended

features.name: Tax Rate Mismatch Detection and Resolution
features.description: System detects when tax rates differ between Shopify and Business Central, prevents document creation if rates differ, and allows users to either approve BC rates or override with Shopify rates, with changes applied based on document date.
caveats: Rate overrides apply to all orders on the same date
Serious discrepancies always require manual review regardless of settings
Addresses transportation and product lines separately

features.name: Shopify Order Number as Sales Document Number
features.description: New setting in this release that uses the Shopify order number as the sales order document number in Business Central for better traceability.

features.name: Automatic Refund Document Creation
features.description: When a refund is created in Shopify, the system automatically creates a sales return document in Business Central using the same tax configuration parameters as the original sales order.
caveats: Uses same tax parameters as defined on sales order
No additional AI review required if confidence is high
